diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period between completed bodies. The candidate implemented a one-shot sequence (period 0) and placed the cycle period as a trailing delay, causing the first action to fire at t=0 instead of t=180000. Evidence F2 shows the IR acted at 190000ms while the candidate did nothing, confirming the missing initial delay and incorrect repetition structure.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 180000 to match the IR cycle period. Rewrote the script to be a one-shot initialization (period 0) that waits for the cycle period before executing the body, ensuring the first action occurs at t=180000 and subsequent actions repeat every 180000ms.
